```python
file_path = "/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/54612da3-fd56-4941-80f4-5eb82330de25.xlsx"

print("Total wheels (steam section):", steam_df['Wheels'].sum())
```
